metaTitle: Drawmon — Your doodle. Your winning move.
metaDescription: Meet the enemy. Draw your answer. Take your hand-drawn monster into a 50-floor adventure for iPhone and iPad. Discover how a doodle becomes a winning move.
heroKicker: A drawing adventure powered by your ideas
heroLead: A body made of water can put out a flame. Look at your opponent. Draw your answer. Your doodle becomes your adventure companion.
demoEyebrow: Your first step with the hero
demoTitle1: A companion to put out the flame.
demoIntro: Look at the enemy. Draw your idea. Bring your companion to life in the app. Start here with the same 128 × 128 drawing grid.
stepEffect: Bring it to life in the app
demoInitial: This candle guardian launches fireballs from the flame on its head. What could you draw to stop it?
contrastTitle: One doodle does not solve every battle.
contrastBody: Your water companion may beat a flame, then struggle against water. Observe. Redraw. That little moment of “What if I tried this?” is the fun.
worldBody: From woodland corridors to crystal halls, gardens above the clouds and a library of stars. Climb the Blank Tower with your companion and meet its 50 guardians.
featuresTitle: A whole adventure from one little drawing.
feature1Body: Your drawing inspires a name and a special move. Words bring the battle to life: enemies react when an idea works, and you can see why another one did not.
feature2Title: A loss can spark your next idea.
feature2Body: Redraw and try again. Your companions stay in your library, so you can keep exploring different ideas.
feature3Title: The hero is on your side.
feature3Body: Celebrate together when an idea works. Think of a new approach when it does not. The hero keeps cheering for the companion you drew.
canvasNote: Draw and save a PNG here. Bring your drawing to life and battle alongside it in the app!
answer1: You need an iPhone or iPad with iOS or iPadOS 27 or later, Apple Intelligence enabled, and a model that supports image input.
answer2: Drawmon is in development and preparing for release. An App Store release date will be announced when it is ready.
faq3: Do I have to be good at drawing?
answer3: This is not a drawing contest. Shapes, tools and materials help communicate your idea. Look at the opponent and experiment.
faq4: Where are drawings and progress saved?
answer4: The app saves your drawings and adventure on your device. There is autosave and three manual bookmarks. Ads and purchases use an internet connection.
answer5: This website is available in 16 language and script settings. The app's normal language choices are Japanese and English. Fourteen additional settings are being developed as previews.
faq6: How do redrawing and summoning work?
answer6: Creating a drawing and redrawing are free. Watch an ad to summon a saved companion, then retry that floor together. A one-time purchase removes ads.
supportTitle: A little help. A new idea.
supportBody: Report a problem, ask a question, or share an idea for the game.
supportNote: A GitHub account is required. Posts are public. Do not include personal information such as your full name or email address.
supportGuide: For a bug report, include the steps, game version, device and OS version.
footerLine: One little line. A whole new world.
footerNote: Features are in development. This page includes promotional illustrations and illustrative demonstrations.
heroWelcome: Let’s go on an adventure with your companion!
drawPrompt: Could a body made of water put out that flame? Try a blue droplet with a face, arms or legs.
editorHelp: Draw · Zoom with + / − · Use the hand to pan
saveSize: PNG export: 1024 × 1024. Your 128 × 128 pixels are enlarged 8× without blurring.
nativeTitle: In the app, your drawing becomes a companion.
nativeBody: Tap “Bring your companion to life” in the app to discover its name and special move. With the hero cheering you on, take your idea into battle.
